# Required GitHub status-check names. Each must be a job `name:` in a workflow
# that runs on pull_request (ci.yml, ship-loop.yml).
# scripts/gates/check-required-ci-jobs.sh fails a PR when this list drifts.
# GitHub treats a skipped required check as passing, and a workflow its trigger
# leaves out keeps the check pending. A continue-on-error: on the job lets the run
# pass when the job fails, and on a step lets the job pass when the step fails. So
# the one job that supplies each name has no if:, needs: or continue-on-error:,
# none of its steps has continue-on-error:, and its pull_request trigger holds
# only types:, with opened, synchronize and reopened. The gate enforces this. The
# one-job rule covers literal names: a job whose name is an expression or that has
# a matrix is not counted.
Lint
Type Check
Unit Tests
Integration Tests (1/2)
Integration Tests (2/2)
Gate Self Tests
Ship loop
